title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Rate Card: Rate Periods by Equipment Class
content:
Every Ridgeline Tool Rental item carries a daily rate on the rate card, and that daily rate is fixed on the rental agreement. The other rate periods of an item are set from its daily rate by the figures of its equipment class below.

## Rate periods

- **Four-hour period**: offered only in the classes marked below; priced as a percentage of the item's daily rate.
- **Day**: one daily rate period, counted from checkout, of the length shown for the class.
- **Week**: seven periods of 24 hours, priced as a multiple of the daily rate.
- **Four weeks**: 28 periods of 24 hours, priced as a multiple of the daily rate.
- **Weekend special**: checkout on a Saturday and return by one hour after store opening on the following Monday, priced as a multiple of the daily rate, in the classes that offer it.
- **Return grace**: the minutes after the end of a rate period within which a return is not charged for further time.

## Schedule A: period pricing

| Equipment class | Four-hour period offered | Four-hour rate, percent of daily | Weekly rate, times daily | Four-week rate, times daily | Day length, hours |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | yes | 70 | 4.00 | 12.00 | 24 |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | yes | 70 | 4.00 | 12.00 | 24 |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | yes | 70 | 4.00 | 12.00 | 24 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | yes | 70 | 3.50 | 10.00 | 24 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | no | 0 | 3.50 | 9.00 | 24 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | no | 0 | 3.50 | 9.00 | 24 |

## Schedule B: billing terms of the class

| Equipment class | Return grace, minutes | Billed as lowest-cost combination of periods | Weekend special offered | Weekend special, times daily | Unused time refunded on early return | Rental time earns the ProBuild rental discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 59 | yes | yes | 1.50 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care | 59 | yes | yes | 1.50 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape | 59 | yes | yes | 1.50 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 59 | yes | no | 0.00 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | 29 | yes | no | 0.00 | no | yes |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 29 | yes | no | 0.00 | no | no |

A four-hour rate of 0 and a weekend multiple of 0.00 appear only where that period is not offered at all.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical daily rate of 40.00)

| Class | Four-hour | Weekly | Four-week | Weekend special |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools | 28.00 | 160.00 | 480.00 | 60.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Concrete and Masonry | 28.00 | 140.00 | 400.00 | not offered |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting | not offered | 140.00 | 360.00 | not offered |

The 40.00 daily rate is an illustrative input only; each item's own daily rate is the one printed on its agreement.
